summary: Tango Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on public offering of 18,166,667 common shares and pre-funded warrants to purchase 1,833,395 shares at $30.00 per share (pre-funded warrant price $29.999). Underwriters (J.P. Morgan, Leerink, Cantor, Stifel) receive a 5.5% discount; proceeds to the company ~$567M. Shares trade on Nasdaq under TNGX; last price $31.56. No board recommendation or advisor named; this is an ordinary equity capital raise, not a special situation. Watch for dilutive overhang on stock price; no risk-arb angle as it's not a merger or acquisition.
